name: LiteLLM
description: LiteLLM is an OpenAI-compatible gateway for multiple LLM providers with virtual API keys, usage tracking, and spending budgets.

notes.text: Open https://<container-ip>/ui and accept the self-signed certificate. Sign in as admin with the generated LITELLM_MASTER_KEY from /opt/litellm/.env.
Plain HTTP on port 80 is enabled by default. Set var_litellm_http=no at install time to redirect HTTP to HTTPS. Use HTTPS for the admin UI.
Updates apply the LiteLLM and Prisma versions selected by the script. Each upgrade saves the previous environment, configuration, and a PostgreSQL dump under /opt/litellm-backup.*.
